description: List Obscurify.ai chat models with their IDs, context window, price per million input/output tokens (USD), tool-calling support and the plan they need (any = every account with a balance; casual = Casual or Pro; pro = Pro only). Filter by name, plan, price or tool support. Use it to find a model ID for ask, chat or second_opinion, or the cheapest model with what you need. Doesn't need an API key.

max_output_price.description: Only models whose output price is at most this many USD per million tokens.

plan.description: Only models usable on this plan: any (Pay As You Go and up), casual, or pro (everything).

search.description: Case-insensitive text to match in the model ID or name, e.g. "claude", "deepseek", "coder".

sort.description: Sort order (default id). price = cheapest output first.

tools_only.description: Only models that support tool/function calling.

name: list_models
title: List models
